# GNOME Evolution adding a CalDAV task list by its home: a getctag check, an
# ETag listing at depth 1 and a multiget, then a later poll whose changed
# getctag leads to a fresh ETag listing and a GET of the changed object.
# Written from published client behaviour (evolution-data-server's CalDAV
# backend as documented, RFC 4791), not captured traffic.

### the home, found from the principal the user typed
PROPFIND {principal}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><prop><C:calendar-home-set/><displayname/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set 200 {home}

### the lists
PROPFIND {home}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><prop><displayname/><resourcetype/><C:supported-calendar-component-set/><CS:getctag/><C:calendar-description/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
PROP {web} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-description 200 Tasks of Web (web)

### the getctag of the list
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><prop><CS:getctag/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
SAVE ctag0 {infra} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag

### the ETags
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:"><prop><getetag/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
SAVE etag0 {infra}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag
PROP {infra} {DAV:}getetag 404

### the objects
REPORT {infra}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<C:calendar-multiget xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><prop><getetag/><C:calendar-data/></prop><href>{infra}{open1}.ics</href><href>{infra}{open2}.ics</href><href>{infra}{done}.ics</href></C:calendar-multiget>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3

### a poll with nothing changed
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><prop><CS:getctag/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
SAVE ctag1 {infra} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag
SAME ctag0 ctag1

### a task is renamed in the browser
DO retitle open1

### the next poll sees the change
PROPFIND {infra}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><prop><CS:getctag/><getetag/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
SAVE ctag2 {infra} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag
DIFFERENT ctag1 ctag2
SAVE etag1 {infra}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag
DIFFERENT etag0 etag1

### the changed object, unless it is already held
GET {infra}{open1}.ics
If-None-Match: {etag0}

EXPECT 200
HAS SUMMARY:Rotate keys (edited)
HEADER ETag {etag1}

### and again with the new tag
GET {infra}{open1}.ics
If-None-Match: {etag1}

EXPECT 304
